title: Learning Loco-Manipulation From SMPC Demonstrations With Sparse Offline-to-Online RL
abstract: arXiv:2608.12063v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Integrating locomotion and manipulation is essential for robot autonomy, but scaling standard Reinforcement Learning (RL) to complex tasks is severely bottlenecked by the slow, manual process of dense reward shaping. To bypass this limitation, we leverage Sample-based Model Predictive Control (SMPC) entirely in simulation as an automated, rapidly tunable expert to generate massive offline datasets. Because this data solves the fundamental exploration problem, we can train an off-policy RL agent using purely sparse task rewards, drastically reducing the time required to learn new skills and eliminating the need for manual tuning. Integrating this high-level agent with a low-level dynamic stability controller yields more optimal behaviors that strictly align with true task objectives, ultimately allowing the learned policies to surpass the original optimal control teacher. translated_title: 从SMPC演示中学习带有稀疏离线到在线强化学习的运动-操作技能
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.12063v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：将运动与操作集成对于机器人自主性至关重要，但标准强化学习（RL）在复杂任务中的扩展受到密集奖励塑形缓慢且手动过程的严重瓶颈限制。为绕过这一限制，我们完全在仿真中利用基于样本的模型预测控制（SMPC）作为自动化、可快速调优的专家，生成大规模离线数据集。由于该数据解决了基本探索问题，我们可以仅使用稀疏任务奖励训练离策略RL智能体，大幅减少学习新技能所需时间，并消除手动调优需求。将此高层智能体与低层动态稳定性控制器集成，可产生更优行为，严格符合真实任务目标，最终使学习策略超越原始最优控制教师。我们通过成功验证此仿真到现实框架的鲁棒性来证明其有效性。
tldr: 本文提出一种利用SMPC在仿真中自动生成离线数据、结合稀疏奖励的离线到在线强化学习框架，实现运动-操作技能学习，且学习策略能超越原始控制专家。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a framework that leverages SMPC to automatically generate offline data in simulation and combines sparse-reward offline-to-online RL for learning loco-manipulation skills, with learned policies surpassing the original control expert.
